<style id="mgx-styles">
#mgx-home{
  --mgx-accent:#5856d6; --mgx-accent-2:#7c7aff; --mgx-hot:#fb7308;
  --mgx-gold:#f5b942; --mgx-silver:#9fa8b5; --mgx-bronze:#c98d5c;
  --mgx-bg:transparent; --mgx-card:#ffffff; --mgx-line:#e6e8ef;
  --mgx-text:#1d2129; --mgx-muted:#6b7280; --mgx-chip:#f2f3f8;
  --mgx-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(15,18,35,.06),0 8px 24px rgba(15,18,35,.07);
  --mgx-shadow-hover:0 4px 10px rgba(15,18,35,.10),0 14px 34px rgba(88,86,214,.16);
  font-family:'Nunito Sans',Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;
  color:var(--mgx-text);
}
body.nightmode #mgx-home{
  --mgx-card:#15171c; --mgx-line:#262a33; --mgx-text:#e8eaf0;
  --mgx-muted:#8b93a3; --mgx-chip:#1e2129;
  --mgx-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
  --mgx-shadow-hover:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 16px 40px rgba(124,122,255,.14);
}
#mgx-home *{box-sizing:border-box}
#mgx-home a{text-decoration:none}
#mgx-home img{display:block}

.mgx-wrap{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px}
.mgx-section{margin:34px 0}
.mgx-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px}
.mgx-head .mgx-ico{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:15px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--mgx-accent),var(--mgx-accent-2));box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(88,86,214,.35);flex:none}
.mgx-head .mgx-ico.hot{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff6a00,#ffb347);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(251,115,8,.35)}
.mgx-head .mgx-ico.gold{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e8a020,#ffd97a);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(245,185,66,.4)}
.mgx-head h2{font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:800;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.2px}
.mgx-head .mgx-sub{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--mgx-muted);margin-top:1px}
.mgx-head .mgx-right{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.mgx-more{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--mgx-accent-2);background:var(--mgx-chip);border:1px solid var(--mgx-line);padding:7px 14px;border-radius:999px;transition:.2s}
.mgx-more:hover{background:var(--mgx-accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--mgx-accent)}

.mgx-tabs{display:inline-flex;background:var(--mgx-chip);border:1px solid var(--mgx-line);border-radius:999px;padding:3px;gap:2px}
.mgx-tab{border:none;cursor:pointer;background:transparent;color:var(--mgx-muted);font-family:inherit;font-size:.76rem;font-weight:700;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:999px;transition:.2s;white-space:nowrap}
.mgx-tab:hover{color:var(--mgx-text)}
.mgx-tab.on{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--mgx-accent),var(--mgx-accent-2));color:#fff;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(88,86,214,.4)}

.mgx-hero{position:relative;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#221c4e,#171332);overflow:hidden}
.mgx-hero-track{position:relative;height:460px}
.mgx-hero-slide{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .9s ease,visibility .9s ease;z-index:1}
.mgx-hero-slide.on{opacity:1;visibility:visible;z-index:2}
.mgx-hero-bg{position:absolute;inset:-40px;background-size:cover;background-position:center 20%;filter:blur(22px) saturate(1.3) brightness(.5);transform:scale(1.12)}
.mgx-hero-fade{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(28,23,62,.93) 0%,rgba(28,23,62,.58) 45%,rgba(28,23,62,.28) 100%),linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(23,19,50,.95) 0%,rgba(23,19,50,0) 40%)}
.mgx-hero-inner{position:relative;z-index:2;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:34px;padding-top:10px}
.mgx-hero-cover{flex:none;width:205px;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.65),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.09);transform:rotate(-1.2deg);transition:.35s}
.mgx-hero-cover:hover{transform:rotate(0deg) scale(1.03)}
.mgx-hero-cover img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:288/412;object-fit:cover}
.mgx-hero-info{color:#fff;min-width:0;max-width:640px}
.mgx-hero-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.6px;padding:6px 13px;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--mgx-accent),var(--mgx-accent-2));box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(88,86,214,.5);margin-bottom:14px;color:#fff}
.mgx-hero-badge.hot{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff5f00,#ffae42);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(251,115,8,.5)}
.mgx-hero-badge.gold{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c98413,#f5c05a);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(245,185,66,.45)}
.mgx-hero-title{font-size:2.15rem;line-height:1.12;font-weight:900;margin:0 0 12px;letter-spacing:-.5px;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.6);display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.mgx-hero-meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px;font-size:.8rem}
.mgx-hero-meta .m{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);padding:5px 11px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700}
.mgx-hero-meta .m .fa-star{color:var(--mgx-gold)}
.mgx-hero-meta .m .dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#3ddc84;box-shadow:0 0 8px #3ddc84}
.mgx-hero-desc{font-size:.86rem;line-height:1.55;color:#c3c7d4;margin:0 0 20px;max-width:560px;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.mgx-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-family:inherit;font-size:.86rem;font-weight:800;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:10px;border:none;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}
.mgx-btn.primary{color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--mgx-accent),var(--mgx-accent-2));box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(88,86,214,.5)}
.mgx-btn.primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(88,86,214,.65)}
.mgx-btn.ghost{color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
.mgx-btn.ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18)}
.mgx-hero-info .mgx-btn{margin-right:10px;margin-top:4px}
.mgx-hero-dots{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:14px;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:7px;z-index:5}
.mgx-hero-dots button{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:6px;border:none;padding:0;cursor:pointer;background:rgba(255,255,255,.35);transition:.25s}
.mgx-hero-dots button.on{width:26px;background:var(--mgx-accent-2)}

.mgx-rail{position:relative}
.mgx-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scroll-behavior:smooth;padding:6px 2px 18px;scrollbar-width:none}
.mgx-row::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.mgx-arrow{position:absolute;top:38%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:5;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--mgx-line);background:var(--mgx-card);color:var(--mgx-text);cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:14px;box-shadow:var(--mgx-shadow);transition:.2s;opacity:.94}
.mgx-arrow:hover{background:var(--mgx-accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--mgx-accent)}
.mgx-arrow.prev{left:-14px}
.mgx-arrow.next{right:-14px}

.mgx-card{display:block;flex:none;width:152px;scroll-snap-align:start;position:relative;color:var(--mgx-text)}
.mgx-card .cv{display:block;position:relative;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:288/412;background:linear-gradient(110deg,var(--mgx-chip) 8%,var(--mgx-line) 18%,var(--mgx-chip) 33%);background-size:200% 100%;animation:mgx-shimmer 1.4s linear infinite;box-shadow:var(--mgx-shadow);transition:.25s}
.mgx-card:hover .cv{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:var(--mgx-shadow-hover)}
.mgx-card .cv img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:.35s}
.mgx-card:hover .cv img{transform:scale(1.06)}
.mgx-card .cv:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(5,6,10,.72) 0%,rgba(5,6,10,0) 42%)}
.mgx-card .rate{position:absolute;top:8px;right:8px;z-index:2;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:800;color:#fff;background:rgba(10,11,16,.72);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);padding:4px 8px;border-radius:7px}
.mgx-card .rate .fa-star{color:var(--mgx-gold);font-size:.6rem}
.mgx-card .chp{position:absolute;right:9px;bottom:8px;z-index:2;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:800;color:#fff;letter-spacing:.2px}
.mgx-card .rank{position:absolute;left:-4px;bottom:44px;z-index:3;font-size:2.9rem;line-height:1;font-weight:900;color:var(--mgx-card);-webkit-text-stroke:2px var(--mgx-accent-2);text-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.35);font-family:'Nunito Sans',sans-serif;pointer-events:none}
.mgx-card.r1 .rank{-webkit-text-stroke:2px var(--mgx-gold)}
.mgx-card .t{display:-webkit-box;margin:9px 2px 0;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1.3;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;min-height:2.1em}
.mgx-card .nb{position:absolute;top:8px;left:8px;z-index:2;font-size:.62rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:1px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#12b76a,#3ddc84);padding:4px 8px;border-radius:7px;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(18,183,106,.45)}
@keyframes mgx-shimmer{to{background-position:-200% 0}}

.mgx-lb{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}
.mgx-lb-col{min-width:0;background:var(--mgx-card);border:1px solid var(--mgx-line);border-radius:16px;padding:16px;box-shadow:var(--mgx-shadow)}
.mgx-lb-col h3{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:.95rem;font-weight:800;margin:0 0 12px;padding-bottom:11px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--mgx-line)}
.mgx-lb-col h3 i{color:var(--mgx-accent-2)}
.mgx-lb-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:7px 6px;border-radius:11px;transition:.18s;min-width:0;color:var(--mgx-text)}
.mgx-lb-item:hover{background:var(--mgx-chip)}
.mgx-lb-item .n{flex:none;width:26px;text-align:center;font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:900;color:var(--mgx-muted);font-style:italic}
.mgx-lb-item.n1 .n{color:var(--mgx-gold);font-size:1.25rem}
.mgx-lb-item.n2 .n{color:var(--mgx-silver);font-size:1.15rem}
.mgx-lb-item.n3 .n{color:var(--mgx-bronze);font-size:1.1rem}
.mgx-lb-item img{flex:none;width:42px;height:58px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.mgx-lb-item .inf{min-width:0;overflow:hidden}
.mgx-lb-item .inf .tt{font-size:.8rem;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.mgx-lb-item .inf .st{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:.7rem;color:var(--mgx-muted);margin-top:3px;font-weight:600}
.mgx-lb-item .inf .st .fa-star{color:var(--mgx-gold);font-size:.62rem}

.mgx-upd{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(315px,1fr));gap:13px}
.mgx-upd-card{position:relative;display:flex;gap:13px;background:var(--mgx-card);border:1px solid var(--mgx-line);border-radius:14px;padding:11px;box-shadow:var(--mgx-shadow);transition:.22s;overflow:hidden;color:var(--mgx-text)}
.mgx-upd-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--mgx-shadow-hover);border-color:var(--mgx-accent)}
.mgx-upd-card .cv{flex:none;position:relative;width:76px;height:106px;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden}
.mgx-upd-card .cv img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.mgx-upd-card .inf{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:5px;flex:1}
.mgx-upd-card .tt{font-size:.88rem;font-weight:800;line-height:1.25;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.mgx-upd-card .ch{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;align-self:flex-start;font-size:.73rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--mgx-accent-2);background:var(--mgx-chip);border:1px solid var(--mgx-line);padding:4px 10px;border-radius:7px}
.mgx-upd-card .mt{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:.7rem;color:var(--mgx-muted);font-weight:600}
.mgx-upd-card .mt .fresh{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#3ddc84;box-shadow:0 0 7px #3ddc84;animation:mgx-pulse 1.6s ease infinite;flex:none}
.mgx-upd-card .mt img{width:22px;height:14px;border-radius:2px;border:1px solid var(--mgx-line)}
.mgx-upd-card .mt .fa-star{color:var(--mgx-gold)}
.mgx-upd-card .hotf{position:absolute;top:0;right:0;font-size:.62rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.8px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ff5f00,#ffae42);padding:5px 11px;border-bottom-left-radius:11px}
.mgx-upd-card .hearts{position:absolute;right:10px;bottom:9px;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--mgx-muted)}
.mgx-upd-card .hearts i{color:#ef476f}
@keyframes mgx-pulse{50%{opacity:.35}}

.mgx-gen{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px}
.mgx-pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:.79rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--mgx-text);background:var(--mgx-card);border:1px solid var(--mgx-line);padding:9px 16px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:var(--mgx-shadow);transition:.2s}
.mgx-pill i{color:var(--mgx-accent-2)}
.mgx-pill:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:var(--mgx-accent);color:var(--mgx-accent-2);box-shadow:var(--mgx-shadow-hover)}
.mgx-pill.fill{color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--mgx-accent),var(--mgx-accent-2));border-color:transparent}
.mgx-pill.fill i{color:#fff}

  var cache = {};

  window.mgxScroll = function(id, dir){
    var el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) el.scrollBy({left: dir * Math.round(el.clientWidth * 0.85), behavior: 'smooth'});
  };

  function esc(s){ return String(s).replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/"/g,'"'); }
  function chapLabel(c){ return c ? 'Ch. ' + esc(String(c).replace(/-eng-li$/,'')) : ''; }

  function fetchPeriod(period){
    if (cache[period]) return Promise.resolve(cache[period]);
    return fetch('/api/most-viewed/?period=' + period)
      .then(function(r){ if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); return r.json(); })
      .then(function(d){ cache[period] = d.manga || []; return cache[period]; });
  }

    var heroTrack = document.getElementById('mgx-hero-track');
  var heroDots = document.getElementById('mgx-hero-dots');
  var hero = document.getElementById('mgx-hero');
  var heroCur = 0, heroTimer = null, heroSlides = [], dotEls = [];

  function heroGo(i){
    if (!heroSlides.length) return;
    heroSlides[heroCur].classList.remove('on'); if (dotEls[heroCur]) dotEls[heroCur].classList.remove('on');
    heroCur = (i + heroSlides.length) % heroSlides.length;
    heroSlides[heroCur].classList.add('on'); if (dotEls[heroCur]) dotEls[heroCur].classList.add('on');
  }
  function heroRestart(){
    clearInterval(heroTimer);
    if (heroSlides.length > 1) heroTimer = setInterval(function(){ heroGo(heroCur + 1); }, 6000);
  }
  function heroInit(){
    heroSlides = [].slice.call(heroTrack.querySelectorAll('.mgx-hero-slide'));
    heroDots.innerHTML = ''; dotEls = []; heroCur = 0;
    heroSlides.forEach(function(s, i){
      s.classList.toggle('on', i === 0);
      if (heroSlides.length < 2) return;
      var d = document.createElement('button');
      d.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Slide ' + (i + 1));
      if (i === 0) d.className = 'on';
      d.addEventListener('click', (function(idx){ return function(){ heroGo(idx); heroRestart(); }; })(i));
      heroDots.appendChild(d); dotEls.push(d);
    });
    heroRestart();
  }
  hero.addEventListener('mouseenter', function(){ clearInterval(heroTimer); });
  hero.addEventListener('mouseleave', heroRestart);
  var tx = null;
  hero.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){ tx = e.touches[0].clientX; }, {passive: true});
  hero.addEventListener('touchend', function(e){
    if (tx === null) return;
    var dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - tx; tx = null;
    if (Math.abs(dx) > 45) { heroGo(heroCur + (dx < 0 ? 1 : -1)); heroRestart(); }
  }, {passive: true});
  heroInit();

  var HERO_BADGES = [
    ['gold', 'fa-crown', '#1 TRENDING TODAY'],
    ['hot', 'fa-fire', 'HOT RIGHT NOW'],
    ['', 'fa-bolt', 'READERS' PICK']
  ];
  function heroSlide(m, i){
    var b = HERO_BADGES[i] || HERO_BADGES[2];
    var rate = m.rating > 0 ? '<span class="m"><i class="fas fa-star"></i> ' + m.rating.toFixed(1) + '</span>' : '';
    var ch = m.latest_chapter ? '<span class="m"><i class="fas fa-book-open"></i> ' + chapLabel(m.latest_chapter) + '</span>' : '';
    var href = '/manga/' + esc(m.slug) + '/';
    return '<section class="mgx-hero-slide">' +
      '<div class="mgx-hero-bg" style="background-image:url(\'' + FULL + esc(m.cover_url) + '\')"></div>' +
      '<div class="mgx-hero-fade"></div>' +
      '<div class="mgx-hero-inner mgx-wrap">' +
      '<a class="mgx-hero-cover" href="' + href + '" title="' + esc(m.name) + '">' +
      '<img src="' + IMG + esc(m.cover_url) + '" alt="' + esc(m.name) + '"></a>' +
      '<div class="mgx-hero-info">' +
      '<span class="mgx-hero-badge ' + b[0] + '"><i class="fas ' + b[1] + '"></i> ' + b[2] + '</span>' +
      '<h2 class="mgx-hero-title">' + esc(m.name) + '</h2>' +
      '<div class="mgx-hero-meta">' + rate + ch + '<span class="m"><span class="dot"></span> Ongoing</span></div>' +
      '<a class="mgx-btn primary" href="' + href + '"><i class="fas fa-book-open"></i> Read Now</a>' +
      '<a class="mgx-btn ghost" href="' + href + '"><i class="far fa-bookmark"></i> Details</a>' +
      '</div></div></section>';
  }

    function trendCard(m, i){
    var rate = m.rating > 0 ? '<span class="rate"><i class="fas fa-star"></i> ' + m.rating.toFixed(1) + '</span>' : '';
    var chp = m.latest_chapter ? '<span class="chp">' + chapLabel(m.latest_chapter) + '</span>' : '';
    return '<a class="mgx-card has-rank' + (i === 0 ? ' r1' : '') + '" href="/manga/' + esc(m.slug) + '/" title="' + esc(m.name) + '">' +
      '<span class="cv">' + rate + '<img src="' + IMG + esc(m.cover_url) + '" alt="' + esc(m.name) + '" loading="lazy">' + chp + '</span>' +
      '<span class="rank">' + (i + 1) + '</span>' +
      '<span class="t">' + esc(m.name) + '</span></a>';
  }

  var TITLES = {'1d': 'Trending Today', '1w': 'Trending This Week', '1m': 'Trending This Month'};

  function renderTrending(period){
    fetchPeriod(period).then(function(list){
      document.getElementById('mgx-tr-row').innerHTML = list.slice(0, 12).map(trendCard).join('');
      document.getElementById('mgx-tr-title').textContent = TITLES[period];
    }).catch(function(){
      if (!document.querySelector('#mgx-tr-row .mgx-card img'))
        document.getElementById('mgx-tr-section').style.display = 'none';
    });
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('#mgx-tr-tabs .mgx-tab').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
      document.querySelectorAll('#mgx-tr-tabs .mgx-tab').forEach(function(b){ b.classList.remove('on'); });
      btn.classList.add('on');
      renderTrending(btn.dataset.period);
    });
  });

    function lbRow(m, i){
    var cls = i === 0 ? ' n1' : i === 1 ? ' n2' : i === 2 ? ' n3' : '';
    var rate = m.rating > 0 ? '<span><i class="fas fa-star"></i> ' + m.rating.toFixed(1) + '</span>' : '';
    var chap = m.latest_chapter ? '<span>' + chapLabel(m.latest_chapter) + '</span>' : '';
    return '<a class="mgx-lb-item' + cls + '" href="/manga/' + esc(m.slug) + '/" title="' + esc(m.name) + '">' +
      '<span class="n">' + (i + 1) + '</span>' +
      '<img src="' + IMG + esc(m.cover_url) + '" alt="' + esc(m.name) + '" loading="lazy">' +
      '<span class="inf"><span class="tt">' + esc(m.name) + '</span><span class="st">' + rate + chap + '</span></span></a>';
  }
  var lbFails = 0;
  function renderLb(period){
    fetchPeriod(period).then(function(list){
      document.getElementById('mgx-lb-' + period).innerHTML = list.slice(0, 5).map(lbRow).join('');
    }).catch(function(){
      if (++lbFails >= 3) document.getElementById('mgx-lb-section').style.display = 'none';
    });
  }

    renderTrending('1d');
  renderLb('1d'); renderLb('1w'); renderLb('1m');
  fetchPeriod('1d').then(function(list){
    var top = list.filter(function(m){ return m.cover_url && m.slug; }).slice(0, 3);
    if (!top.length) return;
    var welcome = document.getElementById('mgx-hero-welcome');
    welcome.insertAdjacentHTML('beforebegin', top.map(heroSlide).join(''));
    heroInit();
  }).catch(function(){  });
})();
</script>
